g.text: V100 kernel observations — normalized scalar rooflines
Partial first-launch / warmup samples; source stages may be unassigned
Each point is one kernel–precision observation; no benchmark averaging or causal diagnosis.
Clock-adjusted modeled ceilings; add/mul/FMA only. SFU, integer and atomic costs are omitted.
